200+ enterprise clients scaled with cloud-native solutions, reducing deployment latency by 40%  
Senior Platform Engineer at TechNova Inc, building resilient systems for global enterprises. Over 7 years shaping infrastructure that balances innovation with operational reliability. My focus? Turning complex challenges into scalable, repeatable processes that empower teams to deliver faster.  

Specialized in cloud-native architectures, from designing VPCs that scaled with 200% traffic growth to optimizing databases for 10M+ queries/sec. Owned CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment times by 35%, while Kubernetes clusters now manage 500+ nodes across AWS and GCP. Linux automation routines ensure 95%+ system uptime, and network automation tools slash manual tasks by 60%. Mentoring teams on Terraform practices and hybrid cloud strategies has shaped cross-functional collaboration.  

Let’s connect if you’re tackling enterprise-scale challenges or curious about scalable infrastructure solutions. I’m always open to discussing architecture trade-offs or sharing insights on modernizing legacy systems.
